dts-hd-ma.description: H.264 1080p, DTS-HD MA 5.1 (default), AC-3 2.0 192k in the same language with no title or flag (commentary heuristic), SRT

edits.why: FFmpeg cannot encode DTS-HD MA (its dca encoder writes a DTS core only). libavcodec dca_xll.c ff_dca_xll_filter_frame() sets these for a lossless (XLL) stream: profile (AV_PROFILE_DTS_HD_MA{,_X}), sample_fmt S32P for 24-bit storage, bits_per_raw_sample = storage_bit_res (24) and bit_rate = 0, which ffprobe omits from JSON.

dv-p8.description: Dolby Vision profile 8.1 (HDR10-compatible base layer): the HDR10 stream of the 'hdr10' recipe (1080p) plus a DOVI configuration record

edits.why: FFmpeg cannot make a Dolby Vision stream from nothing: libx265 with -dolbyvision 1 needs AV_FRAME_DATA_DOVI_METADATA on every input frame ('Dolby Vision enabled, but received frame without AV_FRAME_DATA_DOVI_METADATA'). The entry is what ffprobe prints for a Matroska BlockAdditionMapping dvcC of profile 8.1: side_data_type (libavcodec) and the field names in ffprobe's order (bin/ffprobe).

dvd-interlaced.description: DVD rip layout: MPEG-2 720x480 29.97i TFF, SAR 32:27 (16:9), AC-3 2.0 eng + fre, VobSub eng + fre, 2 chapters, statistics tags

dvd-interlaced-vob.description: The same DVD title as an MPEG program stream (VOB): stream start offsets, ids

eac3-atmos.description: Web release layout: H.264 1080p, E-AC-3 5.1 640k (Atmos); SRT 'English', 'English [SDH]', 'English [Forced]' (roles from titles only)

edits.why: FFmpeg's eac3 encoder cannot write JOC (Atmos) metadata. libavcodec ac3dec.c sets AV_PROFILE_EAC3_DDP_ATMOS for a stream with JOC; the other fields do not change.

hdr10.description: HEVC Main 10 3840x2160 BT.2020/PQ, mastering display + MaxCLL as stream side data (two libx265 passes), E-AC-3 5.1

hdr10-sei-only.description: HEVC Main 10 1080p BT.2020/PQ from one libx265 pass: the HDR10 metadata is only in SEI (frame side data), so Reframe reads the first frame

hlg.description: HEVC Main 10 1080p50 BT.2020 / HLG (arib-std-b67), no static metadata

pgs.description: H.264 1080p, AC-3 5.1; PGS: eng 'English' default (8 events), eng untitled (1 event: forced heuristic), eng 'English SDH' hearing_impaired (9), hun (8)

edits.why: FFmpeg has no PGS encoder. truehd-atmos.description: Blu-ray remux layout: H.264 1080p, TrueHD 5.1 (Atmos), AC-3 5.1 640k, AC-3 2.0 192k 'Director's Commentary' (title only, no flag)

edits.why: FFmpeg's truehd encoder cannot write the 16-channel (4th substream) Atmos presentation. libavcodec mlpdec.c read_major_sync() sets AV_PROFILE_TRUEHD_ATMOS for it; nothing else (no bit_rate) changes.
